citations.quote: harboring an activating EGFR exon 19 deletion

candidates.description: Presence or absence of an activating EGFR exon-19 deletion in the tumor tissue.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Search the 'Clinical History' or 'Assessment' sections for mentions of 'EGFR' and 'exon-19'.
candidates.measurement_definition: Positive if the patient is documented to have an 'EGFR exon-19 deletion' or 'activating EGFR exon 19 deletion'; negative if the mutation is explicitly absent or not mentioned.
candidates.name: EGFR exon-19 mutation status
candidates.uncertainty: It is unclear if other EGFR mutations (outside exon-19) are present and should be included in a broader EGFR-positive category.

citations.quote: ECOG 1, asymptomatic aside from mild dry cough

candidates.description: A standardized scale used to assess the functional status of cancer patients, where higher numbers indicate greater disability.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Identify the numerical value following 'ECOG' or 'performance status' within the physical examination or assessment sections.
candidates.measurement_definition: The integer value (0-4) reported as 'ECOG' or 'ECOG PS' in the clinical notes.
candidates.name: ECOG Performance Status
candidates.uncertainty: The specific timepoint of the assessment (e.g., at diagnosis vs. post-surgery) is not consistently specified for all patients.

limitations: Small number of patients provided in the evidence.
Inconsistent timing of performance status assessments across patient records.
Molecular profiling is only reported for a subset of patients.
summary: The provided evidence describes baseline clinical characteristics of patients with lung adenocarcinoma, supporting the extraction of molecular driver status (EGFR exon-19 deletion) and functional status (ECOG performance status) as measurable variables.
